# Isaiah Chapter 24 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 23 verses]*

*Isaiah's apocalypse; earth defiled; curse devours; joy ceased; cosmic judgment; God reigns on Zion*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 24 (The LORD's Devastation) addresses isaiah's apocalypse; earth defiled; curse devours; joy ceased; cosmic judgment; god reigns on zion. The key verse — "The LORD will punish the host of heaven in heaven, and the kings of the earth on the earth" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
